speaker: ARIN [YOU]
text: The signal is stabilizing. Just a few more seconds.

speaker: ARIN [YOU]
text: Override accepted. Hold together, just hold together...

speaker: MIRA
text: Arin, abort! I'll get you out of here!

speaker: ARIN [YOU]
text: ...that voice. It's been you the whole way through.

speaker: MIRA
text: Mira Sen. Chief engineer. I stayed behind to run the shutdown while you ran. I didn't make it out.

speaker: MIRA
text: What's guided you isn't me reaching you from somewhere. It's your own memory of me — the truth you buried. Finish it. Enter the sequence.
